defaults.note: Design defaults only; they do not alter any ENGINE-TREND-19/20 runtime threshold and require later validation/configuration.

contracts.hypothesis_requirement: DOWN regime or confirmed DOWN_CONTINUATION, with causal bearish structure required in both cases
contracts.entry_trigger: After a closed bearish confirmation candle rejects the causal retest/reclaim zone; confirmation must occur after the retest and use only information available as_of.
contracts.invalidation_rule: A close/reclaim above the rejection high or upper edge of the reclaimed zone invalidates the bearish premise.
contracts.stop_rule: Place beyond the structural invalidation level plus a future-validated market-noise buffer; never derive stop from desired position size or RR.
contracts.target_rule: Choose an unbreached causal objective below entry: previous low, measured-move objective, or support zone. Record all eligible targets and why each existed as_of.
contracts.reward_risk_rule: For each target, RR=(entry-target)/(stop-entry). At least one reachable target must have RR >= min_reward_risk; otherwise NO_TRADE.
contracts.expiration_rule: Expire after expires_after_candles from confirmation, or earlier on invalidation, opposing confirmation, regime/hypothesis staleness, or material zone change.
contracts.conflict_handling: Confirmed bullish reversal/range/trap => NO_TRADE or INVALIDATED if already confirmed. Pending but unresolved conflict => WAIT_CONFIRMATION; expiration turns it into NO_TRADE.

status_rules.TRADE_CANDIDATE: All gates pass and numeric entry, invalidation, stop, target and RR are present.
status_rules.WAIT_CONFIRMATION: Causal retest exists and levels can be defined, but the post-retest confirmation candle is not closed.
status_rules.NO_TRADE: Any hard gate fails before activation.
status_rules.INVALIDATED: A previously valid/pending premise is causally breached.

contracts.entry_trigger: After a closed bullish confirmation candle holds/reclaims the causal breakout/retest zone following a failed breakdown.
contracts.invalidation_rule: A close below the retest low or lower edge of the failed reclaim invalidates the bullish premise.
contracts.stop_rule: Place beyond structural invalidation minus a future-validated market-noise buffer.
contracts.target_rule: Choose an unbreached objective above entry: previous high, measured-move objective, or resistance zone.
contracts.reward_risk_rule: For each target, RR=(target-entry)/(entry-stop). At least one reachable target must have RR >= min_reward_risk; otherwise NO_TRADE.
contracts.expiration_rule: Expire after expires_after_candles from confirmation, or earlier on invalidation, opposing confirmation, regime/hypothesis staleness, or material zone change.
contracts.conflict_handling: Confirmed bearish reversal/range/trap => NO_TRADE or INVALIDATED. Pending unresolved conflict => WAIT_CONFIRMATION.

entry.condition: await bullish close after failed breakdown at 100.0 reclaim zone

contracts.entry_trigger: After a closed inward rejection candle at a confirmed range boundary; long from support rejection or short from resistance rejection. FLAT alone is insufficient.
contracts.invalidation_rule: Acceptance/close beyond the tested range boundary invalidates mean reversion.
contracts.stop_rule: Beyond the tested range boundary and structural invalidation, with a future-validated buffer.
contracts.target_rule: First target is range midline; opposite boundary may be an additional target only if still causal and reachable.
contracts.reward_risk_rule: Use the long or short formula by direction. If the midline and all other valid targets are below min_reward_risk, return NO_TRADE.
contracts.expiration_rule: Expire after 8 candles from boundary rejection or immediately on confirmed breakout/breakdown, range redefinition, or invalidation.
contracts.conflict_handling: Possible boundary break without confirmation => WAIT_CONFIRMATION. Confirmed breakout/breakdown => NO_TRADE; after a pending/candidate setup existed => INVALIDATED.

entry.condition: await inward rejection or confirmed breakout resolution at upper boundary

invalidation.reason: acceptance above audited upper range boundary; exact buffered level is not designed

stop.reason: set only after rejection entry and validated buffer

contracts.invalidation_rule: not applicable; records why no valid premise exists or why a prior premise failed
contracts.reward_risk_rule: missing/uncomputable RR or RR below minimum is itself a NO_TRADE reason
contracts.expiration_rule: Terminal for the evaluated as_of snapshot; a later candle requires a new setup_id/evaluation.
contracts.conflict_handling: UNKNOWN, unresolved hard conflict, stale setup, missing levels, insufficient RR, range/trend conflict, or bad data resolves here.
